status: Caller-bounded legacy clears and texture caps/interface acceptance implemented; overall applicable Wine remains incomplete.

dependencies.scope: Project-owned shipping and diagnostic preprocessing dependencies plus runtime compilation units and build/resource definitions; SDK/toolchain are recorded by version, not included in this project-source closure.

platformIsolation.scope: Same accepted isolated CPU/PCI/VGA/Wasm as prior batch;18 current host project modules frozen/copied before the cohort, including previous shared NV additions. This does not certify concurrent newer main-checkout CPU/NV work.

rejectedCandidate.reason: DDraw4 original19161 query reference regressed while HAL pixels improved; gate rejected and canonical DLL was not changed. R2 retains the legacy API reference while filtering sampling only.

changes: D9WG1.11 CLEAR command-header flag1 appends a typed16-byte caller bounds trailer after the explicit rectangle list. Existing CLEAR prefix/layout and unrelated API flags remain unchanged. Marker is independent of SDK clear_flags, including existing accepted0x80000001 calls.

Legacy Viewport Clear/Clear2 send their own logical viewport bounds in one atomic command. Current device viewport, projection, scissor and state-block records are not modified. Empty legacy rectangle lists retain their no-op contract. Header/trailer reservation failure propagates before memory generation changes; size addition overflow is rejected.

Host carries command-header flags through dispatch and clips caller-bound clear rectangles in render-target absolute coordinates, independently of current device viewport/scissor. Color/depth/stencil share the caller bound; zero/outside/oversized bounds clip safely. Ordinary clear continues its previous viewport/scissor path. Truncated private trailers are rejected as malformed streams before recording render work.

SetTexture recognizes allfive known surface interface views and rejects foreign/null vtables. Owner/depth/stage validation precedes filtering. Device7 discards non-TEXTURE references; legacy HAL retains the query/state-block reference but emits no sampled texture, including rebind and alpha fixup. Older RGB retains ordinary-surface sampling. Filtering precedes upload and recording, preserving reference and accepted-failure-prefix rules.

Existing state-block fixture textures now explicitly carry their intended DDSCAPS_TEXTURE role, plus SDK-shaped caps/device GUID/mock vtables. All170 ordinary and1052 scope/retail comparisons and prior alpha/recording assertions remain. The dedicated five-view caps fixture separately covers ordinary/texture, HAL/RGB, recording, canonical query refs, rollback and invalid arguments.

clearAuthority.scope: Original7 native empty-list/count/flag HRESULT and center-pixel observations retained unchanged. Actual current C emits all9 packet scenes, now retaining real command-header flags and bounded legacy trailers. GPU independently compares9216 pixels with zero error; separate64-pixel color/depth/stencil scenarios test multiple caller bounds against different current viewport/scissor. No new native Windows execution is claimed by a C-generated fixture.

comparison.scope: All original observed descriptor fields and HRESULTs match the final app-local DLL. Acknowledged metadata only, no pixel certificate.

finalMetadataReplay.scope: Exact same final DLL as allfour full suites;45 descriptors/12 HRESULTs match prior independent native fixture. Metadata only, not a pixel certificate.
